बॉलीवुड और साइबर क्राइम का यह नया मामला सुनकर आप भी हैरान रह जाएंगे! 😲

शिवसेना संस्थापक बालासाहेब ठाकरे के पोते और एक्टर ऐश्वर्य ठाकरे साइबर फ्रॉड के शिकार हो गए हैं। रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, 30 October की देर रात 1:30 बजे अंधेरी स्थित घर पर उनके बैंक खाते से पैसे कटने लगे। पहले 307.82 रुपये और फिर 8 मिनट बाद 15,511.98 रुपये कटे, जिसके बाद कुल 6 बार में 19,638.15 रुपये गायब हो गए। 💸

ऐश्वर्य ठाकरे ने Oshiwara पुलिस स्टेशन में शिकायत दर्ज कराई है। The Times of India की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, पुलिस जांच में पता चला है कि यह ट्रांजेक्शन विदेश से हुए हैं और अज्ञात आरोपी के खिलाफ FIR दर्ज कर ली गई है। 🚨

बता दें कि ऐश्वर्य फिल्म Bajirao Mastani में असिस्टेंट डायरेक्टर रहे हैं और Nishaanchi से अपना एक्टिंग डेब्यू किया था। वह जल्द ही Ahaan Panday के साथ फिल्म Beparwah में नजर आने वाले हैं। 🎬

क्या आपके साथ भी कभी ऐसा कोई साइबर फ्रॉड हुआ है? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर शेयर करें! 💭

ctx.text:
Cybercrime is on the rise, and not just the common man, but even those associated with the film industry and politics are falling prey to it. The latest prominent personality to become a victim is Aaishvary Thackeray, the grandson of Shiv Sena founder Balasaheb Thackeray. As per reports, he has lodged a police complaint after money was fraudulently debited from his bank account.
According to a report in The Times of India, Aaishvary Thackeray revealed that he lives with his mother, Smita, and grandmother, Kunda. He was at his residence in Andheri on October 30 when, at around 1:30 am, he received a text message informing him that Rs. 307.82 had been deducted from his bank account. Eight minutes later, he received another message notifying him of a further deduction of Rs. 15,511.98. Four more fraudulent transactions followed, taking the total amount lost to cyber fraud to Rs. 19,638.15.
Hence, Aaishvary Thackeray visited Oshiwara police station and filed a complaint. The Times of India report confirmed that the cops have begun investigating and have found that the transactions had been made overseas. The article also said that an FIR was registered against an unknown cyber fraudster under the provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Information Technology Act.
Aaishvary Thackeray, 30, worked as an assistant director on Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s Bajirao Mastani (2015), starring Ranveer Singh, Deepika Padukone and Priyanka Chopra. Last year, he made his debut as an actor in Anurag Kashyap’s two-part crime comedy saga, Nishaanchi (2025). Aaishvary played a double role in his debut venture and was quite appreciated.
Besides acting, Aaishvary Thackeray also has an interest in music. In Nishaanchi 's first part, he composed and wrote the song 'Pigeon Kabootar' and sang 'Neend Bhi Teri' . In the second part, he composed the 'End Theme' .
In the 2026 YRF (Yash Raj Films) Spy film, Alpha , starring Alia Bhatt and Sharvari, Aaishvary was one of the music programmers on the song 'Massacre', 'Champagne', 'Haaniya' and 'Agni' . He was also one of the lyricists of 'Massacre - Midnight Version' .
Aaishvary Thackeray will next be seen as an actor in Beparwah , which marks Ahaan Panday’s second film after the sleeper blockbuster Saiyaara (2025). Besides Aaishvary and Ahaan, it also stars Sharvari, Bobby Deol and Jimmy Sheirgill. Directed by Ali Abbas Zafar, it releases in cinemas on March 26, 2027.
